verdict.rationale: x402 is a programmatic HTTP payment protocol with no UI. It ships as one-line server middleware and an npm SDK, and backends and agents can pay per request with no signups. A runtime probe confirms the keyless discovery API answers plain GETs, while the facilitator is API-key gated as documented, so unattended automation is clearly supported. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD usage docs or examples, documented non-interactive credential/wallet setup for pipelines, independent hands-on reports of CI automation.
